SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_fraction,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM main.atom AS a
JOIN main.molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
LIMIT 1
